title: Junior Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Spruce is a scale-up building fitness apps. We are looking for a junior-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is on-site in our Eastmere office.

Our stack: kotlin, swift. You will improve app performance and stability, build offline-first features and review code with the team.

Four-day weeks in summer.
